title: Key spammer
description: Taps one key over and over at a rate you choose. The plain starting point for any grind that is just "hold this button".
details:
Pick the key and how long to wait between taps, then Launch. Everything after that is the usual macro — open it in the timeline if you want to add a colour check, a loop count, or a second key.

Installed in PID mode it sends the key to a chosen app in the background. Switch to Global if the game ignores background keys.

config.label: Key to press
config.help: One key name, e.g. e, space, f1.

config.label: Seconds between presses
config.help: 0.1 is ten a second. Very low values can trip a game's anti-cheat.
